thread:
infra-bot: ALERT: p99 streaming latency spike detected in eu-west-2 egress path — SLO breach (streaming-tail > 1200ms), affected routes: /v1/stream/*, estimated impacted customers: small but high-sensitivity. Auto-escalation triggered. :rotating_light:

morgan: seeing this on the dashboard too, p95 up ~300ms but p99 is brutal. Streaming stalls + retransmits.

sarah: paging oncall, I'm moving this to incident channel. @oncall-bot, page next.

oncall-bot: Paging sarah (primary on-call) and ethan (secondary) — acknowledged. :bell:

ethan: I'm on it, joining. Quick ask: is this cross-zone only or same-az?
morgan: early traces show spikes across AZB/AZC egress paths, interzone NAT queues high, DNS RTOs spiking.
alex: I can confirm increased conntrack counts on NAT proxies in eu-west-2a/c, kernel tx drops visible. Logs attached in perf snapshots.

infra-bot: Recent event summary: 2629123100 - conntrack backlog start, 2629123300 - TLS handshake retries rise, 2629123400 - streaming stalls detected by synthetic clients.
luis: running quick health checks now, starting tcpdump on nat-proxy-azc-1.

carol: grabbing customer impact matrix — 7 customers with active streaming sessions during window, none reported degraded audio but higher tail latencies for completions.

morgan: mitigation proposal A: route streaming traffic to eu-west-1 fallback pool for users in impacted prefixes (fast failover). B: restart nat-proxy pods on AZC to clear conntrack. C: increase ephemeral ports on NAT gateways temporarily. Thoughts?
sarah: prioritize non-disruptive options first. Try routing/pin to fallback region for new streams + enable prefix caching to reduce setup load. Then pod restarts in a controlled canary.

ethan: I can push a routing policy to redirect 30% -> eu-west-1 for new sessions, leave existing streams sticky. Will monitor error rates.
alex: before we reroute, consider TLS session resumption compatibility. Some clients don't resume across regions. We should fallback only for non-resumption flows.
luis: confirmed: most sessions are short-lived and re-establish fine. We'll tag sessions with "no-resume" where applicable.

infra-bot: ACTIONS LOGGED: 1) 2629123600 routing canary 30% -> eu-west-1 for /v1/stream/* 2) 2629123700 enable additional conntrack thresholds on nat-proxies 3) 2629123800 schedule rolling restart nat-proxy-azc-1 (canary)

morgan: canary routing in. watching now. p95 drops slightly, p99 still high but trending down for routed subset. :thumbsup:
sarah: good. ethan, keep routing at 30% for 10m and evaluate. If errors or TLS fails >1% roll back.

ethan: 5m in: routed subset p99 = 410ms, local subset p99 = 980ms. errors at 0.2% (TLS resumption issues). continuing.

luis: restarted nat-proxy-azc-1 canary at 2629124022, conntrack cleared, tx drops reduced.

alex: after restart we see immediate improvement on that AZ: p99 dropped from ~1.1s -> ~420ms for that AZ's hosts.

carol: customer-impact update: one small enterprise client saw increased reconnects, CS has opened a ticket but no major data loss.
sarah: escalate to PM and CSM for the affected list, send a short note: "We're mitigating a transient egress networking issue with reroutes and rolling restarts; we'll follow up with RCA."
morgan: also enabling short-lived prefix-level caching to reduce repeated handshakes for chatty streams.

infra-bot: METRICS SNAPSHOT attached: cpu/conntrack/tx-drops per-proxy, DNS RTOs, TLS handshake count. Key: conntrack peaked at 82% of table on azc, tx-drops down after restart.

ethan: 15m after canary routing and restarts: global p99 ~390ms, p95 ~160ms, streaming stall rate reduced by 85%. Recommend gradual rollback of routing to normal over 20m.
sarah: agree. start rollback to shift remaining 30% back over next 10m. Keep restarts for remaining proxies staged with 2-min gaps.

morgan: rollback started at 2629125000. Monitoring for handshake regression.
luis: rolling restart nat-proxy-azb-1 at 2629125224, azb shows similar improvement post-restart.

alex: follow-up note — kernel conntrack hashbucket contention visible under load during short burst; adding mitigation ticket for conntrack tuning + autoscaling NAT proxy pods.

carol: prepping status update for affected customers: concise bullet points + estimated ETA for RCA.
sarah: oncall handoff: @ethan you're owning post-incident monitoring and RCA until 0800 UTC. I'll write the incident stub and severity. Thanks team. :heart:
oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: primary sarah -> secondary ethan at 2629126400.

infra-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated (service recovery observed), monitoring + RCA in progress. Incident assigned SEV-2.

morgan: leaving a runbook note: if conntrack >75% and tx-drops increase, then: 1) scale nat-proxy pods + 2) canary restart az with lowest traffic, 3) route new streams to fallback region 20-30% until stable.
sarah: closing thread for active paging; keep this channel updated with RCA timeline.

ethan: noted, will post RCA draft in ~4h.
